about: flute_vs_trombone: the RMS of every 100 ms block in dB, for each stem and the master (after the master, 2928640 samples) and each bus before the master (the whole mix buffer)
formula: 20 * log10(sqrt(mean(x ** 2)) + 1e-12) over both channels of samples [b * 4800, (b + 1) * 4800); the last block is what is left (640 samples for the stems). Silence is -240

notes.gain_first: the compressor's gain at the first sample of each block (1.0 = not compressing)
notes.gain_min: the compressor's smallest gain inside each block
notes.wet_db: the reverb's part of the mix, after the fold and before the compressor (it is in the master only, in no stem)

sections.about: reelkit.audio.section_levels(audio.wav, spans): what kit.music.main() prints (dBFS of the 16-bit file, both channels)
